name: Celecia
source:
She is a queen who is rumored to be more powerful than any man or demon in the world.

She imposes heavy taxes and oppressive rule on her people (men), and is feared by all.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mawoharamu/mawoharamu_top.html]official site[/url]]
